rate_limits.correction: No numeric hourly limit is published; the fair-use policy requires submitting only one API request at a time.

cors.correction: Browser embedding is not supported; the official fair-use policy says these APIs may not be embedded in websites under NASA's CORS policy.

notes: Official docs list API v1.3, and a March 2026 notice says the API remains operational. The claimed ~1200/hour limit is invented; 1200 in the docs is a TLE input-line limit. CORS policy forbids website embedding. Pricing and no-paid-plan claims are undocumented. The request is valid, but its illustrative signature version 1.2 is stale. The description's "industry standard" claim could not be officially verified.
